dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy with myoclonus, likely secondary to non-convulsive status epilepticus of unknown aetiology

Alternatives:
1. Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis
2. Paraneoplastic (e.g., anti-Hu, anti-Ma2) limbic/brainstem encephalitis
3. Hashimoto's (steroid-responsive) encephalopathy
